verdict.rationale: Snyk documents general risk-based prioritization and risk scoring (issue prevalence, ease of fix, risk factor) but these are described for Snyk Code/SAST, not explicitly tied to reachability analysis for open-source dependency vulnerabilities. There's a generic 'Risk-based prioritization' line on the pricing page but no docs describing call-graph or usage-based reachability scoring for SCA alerts specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of reachability analysis (e.g., function-level call-graph tracing) applied to open-source/dependency vulnerabilities, hands-on or independent confirmation that this reduces false-positive noise in SCA alerts.
